Reel safe-zone package

Instagram puts its buttons, username, caption and menus on top of your video. Keep your hook, your subject and your ask inside the teal box, and they stay visible.

  1. In this package: reel-safe-zone-overlay-1080x1920.png (transparent, for editing) and reel-safe-zone-labeled-guide.png (this picture, for reference).
  2. Editing with layers (CapCut, Canva, Premiere, and similar): put the overlay on the top layer, full screen. Keep hook text, faces, the product and your ask inside the teal box. Delete the overlay layer before you export.
  3. No layers? Follow three rules: hooks go high; stay clear of the right edge; keep the bottom third free of anything important.
  4. Covers: your profile grid crops Reel covers to 3:4 (the white dashed lines). Keep cover text and faces between them.
  5. The numbers: on a 1080 × 1920 frame, keep the top 269 px, the bottom 672 px and 65 px on each side clear. That is Meta's published safe zone for Reels and Stories (14% top, 35% bottom, 6% sides).
Interface layouts change and differ a little by phone. This is a planning guide, not a guarantee: after posting, check your first Reel on your own phone.
